posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
Let me start this out with the key factor: I have OCD. I like to, and try my best at, keep things in order. This specifically goes torward my stuff, including my SotM collection.

Now, I recently showed my Foil Hero collection to a friend and let him look through the box. I've told him before that it was important to me that all my Sentinels stuff stay in order, and he's been good about it in the past. But, well, we're all human. Whilst he was looking at the cards and I was away from the table, he pulled out all the Haka cards to give them a closer look. Long story short, he forgot to put the cards right back and left, and I can't remember where in the hero order Haka goes.

I'd appreciate if anyone else who also has the Foil Hero collection(and hasn't rearanged the cards) could remind me where Haka goes. I know this is most likely a stupid request, but like I said it's gonna bother me until I can figure it out.

Thanks.
